rows.label: Radiocarbon, 1988
rows.tip: Radiocarbon 1988, 95% na katiyakan: AD 1262 hanggang 1312 at AD 1353 hanggang 1384 (nailathala nang binilog bilang 1260 hanggang 1390). Damon at iba pa, Nature 1989.

rows.label: FT-IR (Fanti)
rows.tip: FT-IR spectroscopy sa maluwag na mga hibla, 300 BC, plus o minus 400 taon (may pagwawasto para sa sunog). Grupo ni Fanti, 2015.

rows.label: Raman (Fanti)
rows.tip: Raman spectroscopy sa maluwag na mga hibla, 200 BC, plus o minus 500 taon. Grupo ni Fanti, 2015.

rows.label: Mekanikal (Fanti)
rows.tip: Tibay bago maputol ng iisang hibla, AD 279, plus o minus 216 taon (Monte Carlo reanalysis). Basso, Fanti at Malfi, 2015.

rows.label: Vanillin (Rogers)
rows.tip: Pagkawala ng vanillin sa lignin: 1,300 hanggang 3,000 taong gulang noong 2005. Rogers, Thermochimica Acta, 2005.

rows.label: X-ray (De Caro)
rows.tip: Wide-angle X-ray scattering ng isang sinulid: tugma ang profile ng pagtanda nito sa lino mula sa Masada (AD 55 hanggang 74), at tugma sa mga 20 siglo kung ipagpapalagay lamang ang isang kasaysayan ng pagkakatago. De Caro at iba pa, Heritage, 2022.

controls.description: Lino mula sa isang libingan sa Qasr Ibrim, Nubia; inaasahang ika-11 hanggang ika-12 siglo AD
Lino mula sa isang mummy sa Thebes noong unang bahagi ng ika-2 siglo AD (British Museum)
Mga sinulid mula sa kapa ni San Luis ng Anjou, Saint-Maximin; inaasahang mga AD 1290-1310

sampling.location_on_cloth: A single site on the main body of the cloth, away from patches and charred areas, just above where a sample was removed in 1973, at the bottom left-hand edge where the cloth was separated from its backing (Damon et al. 1989). De Caro et al. 2022 describe this as the corner corresponding to the feet area of the frontal image.

strip_size_mm_other_accounts.source_note: Wikipedia account of the sampling; differs from the 10 x 70 mm given in Nature.

sampling.total_weight_note: About 300 mg cut according to the Wikipedia account; roughly half kept in reserve in Vatican custody.
sampling.per_lab_weight_note: Nature gives about 50 mg per lab. A 2026 summary of Freer-Waters and Jull reports Arizona's first piece was about 40 mg with about 10 mg added, combined 53.9 mg.

sources.label: Damon et al. 1989, kopya ng buong teksto
Wikipedia: Radiocarbon dating of the Shroud of Turin
Farey 2026, buod ng Freer-Waters at Jull 2026

reanalyses.citation: Riani, Atkinson, Fanti, Crosilla 2013, Statistics and Computing, doi:10.1007/s11222-012-9329-5

findings.trend: Age decreases along the length of the strip in every configuration tested (negative slope); significant if Arizona dated only one of its two pieces, which Prof. Jull later confirmed.

reanalyses.citation: Casabianca, Marinelli, Pernagallo, Torrisi 2019, Archaeometry 61(5):1223-1231, doi:10.1111/arcm.12467
reanalyses.raw_data_source: British Museum files released in 2017 after a legal request.

findings.oxford_aggregation: Five measurements reported as three results (2 + 2 + 1).
findings.authors_caveat: The statistical results do not imply that the medieval hypothesis should be ruled out.

reanalyses.citation: Di Lazzaro, Atkinson, Iacomussi, Riani, Ricci, Wadhams 2020, Entropy 22(9):926, doi:10.3390/e22090926

findings.spatial_gradient_note: About 50 radiocarbon years per cm, as summarised from the paper; check the full text before displaying as an exact value.

reanalyses.citation: Walsh and Schwalbe 2020, Journal of Archaeological Science: Reports 29:102015

findings.shift_note: Applied upward to the Zurich and Arizona results; the authors call the cause of any offset a matter of speculation.

reanalyses.citation: Riani, Atkinson, Corbellini, Di Lazzaro et al. 2026, Statistical Methods and Applications 35(3):605-621
reanalyses.notes: Paywalled. I could read only the abstract, which gives no date estimate or trend size. Data and code are on GitHub (UniprJRC/Shroud).

reanalyses.notes: I could not open the full paper. The finding is as reported by IBT (via inkl) and a summary blog by Hugh Farey; verify before quoting.
